observation.command:
cat > /tmp/webinstall2.sh <<'EOS'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
BASE="http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/install.pl"
JAR=/tmp/qisutu-cookies.txt
H="/tmp/step.html"

get() { curl -s -c "$JAR" -b "$JAR" -o "$H" "${BASE}?Step=$1"; }
csrf() { grep -o 'name="CSRFToken" value="[^"]*"' "$H" | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'; }
post() {
  local step="$1"; shift; local token="$1"; shift
  curl -s -c "$JAR" -b "$JAR" -o "$H" -X POST \
    --data-urlencode "Step=${step}" --data-urlencode "CSRFToken=${token}" "$@" "${BASE}"
}

echo "--- STEP 3: GET (database form) ---"
get 3
grep -o 'name="DBHost"[^>]*' "$H" | head -1
grep -o 'name="UseBootstrap"[^>]*' "$H" | head -1
grep -o 'name="DBAdminUser"[^>]*' "$H" | head -1
T=$(csrf); echo "csrf=${T:0:12}..."
echo "--- STEP 3: POST InstallDatabase (bootstrap) ---"
post 3 "$T" --data-urlencode "Action=InstallDatabase" \
  --data-urlencode "DBHost=localhost" --data-urlencode "DBPort=3306" \
  --data-urlencode "DBName=qisutu" --data-urlencode "DBUser=qisutu" \
  --data-urlencode "DBAdminUser=root" --data-urlencode "UseBootstrap=1"
grep -o 'class="qisutu-install-error[^>]*>[^<]*' "$H" | head -5
grep -o 'DatabaseSuccess[^<]*' "$H" | head -1
echo "--- STEP 3: POST ContinueAfterDatabase ---"
T=$(csrf)
post 3 "$T" --data-urlencode "Action=ContinueAfterDatabase"
echo "--- STEP 4: GET (system form) ---"
get 4
T=$(csrf); echo "csrf=${T:0:12}..."
grep -o 'name="HTTPType"' "$H" >/dev/null && echo "system form OK"
echo "--- STEP 4: POST SaveSystem ---"
post 4 "$T" --data-urlencode "Action=SaveSystem" \
  --data-urlencode "HTTPType=http" \
  --data-urlencode "FQDN=localhost" \
  --data-urlencode "WebPath=/qisutu" \
  --data-urlencode "AdminEmail=admin@example.org" \
  --data-urlencode "DefaultLanguage=de" \
  --data-urlencode "Timezone=Europe/Berlin" \
  --data-urlencode "TicketHook=Qisutu" \
  --data-urlencode "AttachmentMaxSize=25"
grep -o 'class="qisutu-install-error[^>]*>[^<]*' "$H" | head -5
echo "--- STEP 5: GET (mail form) ---"
get 5
T=$(csrf); echo "csrf=${T:0:12}..."
grep -o 'name="SkipMail"' "$H" >/dev/null && echo "mail form OK (SkipMail present)"
echo "--- STEP 5: POST SkipMail ---"
post 5 "$T" --data-urlencode "Action=SkipMail"
grep -o 'class="qisutu-install-error[^>]*>[^<]*' "$H" | head -5
echo "--- STEP 6: GET (final) ---"
get 6
T=$(csrf); echo "csrf=${T:0:12}..."
grep -o 'id="qisutu-install-admin-password" class="credential">[^<]*' "$H" | head -1
EOS
chmod +x /tmp/webinstall2.sh && /tmp/webinstall2.sh
